title: Quaint Silky Dutch Meat Skewers
description: A peppery and silky Dutch dish featuring marjoram, this crowd-pleaser is perfect for any occasion, made with agemono-deep-fry method and served in a terracotta dish.
instructions: Preheat the deep fryer to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together marjoram, black pepper, salt, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Add the pork tenderloin pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated pork pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Deep fry the skewers in the preheated oil for 5-6 minutes, or until cooked through.
Remove the skewers from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the skewers hot in a terracotta dish.
Garnish with fresh marjoram leaves, if desired.
